evidence_gaps: No current sanitised runtime forensics branch was available. .strategy_cycle/evidence.json reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS with empty timestamp and generated epoch 0.
Lack of a local VPS resource snapshot (ai-reviews:engineering/ops/latest.json) prevents measured trade latency, RPC round-trips, and infrastructure fee review.
No live execution/preflight logs are available to inspect actual network fee spikes, gas exhaustion, or round-trip sellability metrics across polygon or solana chains.

proposals.downside_risk: SIBOT remains inactive for live execution, avoiding capital risk but missing any potential profits from highly persistent copy-leaders.

evidence.detail: Describes the spot-copy FIFO matching and ranking logic.
Implements EVM ranking, settings and database schema.
Implements Solana signature tracking, signature polling, and Jupiter quote simulation.

proposals.expected_effect: Avoids premature deployment of real funds, protecting user capital while building high-fidelity simulated execution records for top wallets.
proposals.rationale: Due to missing runtime forensics in evidence.json, we cannot assess active copy-trading performance or leader profitability. SIBOT is highly mature with precise FIFO matching and stop-loss/take-profit guards, but it must remain strictly in SHADOW mode across both EVM and Solana to reconstruct long-term wallet history and measure leader persistence.
proposals.shadow_test: Simulate copy-trading on at least 20 leaders per chain over a minimum of 14 days, executing at least 50 virtual trades. Verify that the simulated win-rate remains above 55% and profit factor is above 1.10 after accounting for estimated priority fees and 1.5% max price deterioration. Stop test if simulated virtual drawdown exceeds 15%.

proposals.downside_risk: None, as the strategy is pure and does not execute or sign real transactions in SHADOW mode.

evidence.detail: Establishes Cross Venue Net Arbitrage as the first built-in shadow family.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents capital loss on low-spread arbitrage routes where latency or gas spikes would erase the calculated edge.
proposals.rationale: This strategy relies on fleeting price differences between venues. Real-world execution requires ultra-low latency. Because runtime forensics and RPC latencies are missing from our environment, we must evaluate this strategy purely in SHADOW mode to determine if typical RPC delays (e.g. polygon or solana network congestion) would invalidate the net edge (currently set to 4 basis points minimum).
proposals.shadow_test: Collect at least 1,000 real-time price opportunities across EVM and Solana. Filter those where quote age is <= 1500ms and net edge is >= 4 basis points. Track RPC roundtrip latencies during signal generation. The shadow test is falsified and stops if average roundtrip latency exceeds 800ms or if simulated net P&L after fee/gas estimation is negative.

proposals.downside_risk: May fail to participate in extremely early-stage high-velocity moves where liquidity metrics haven't registered fully yet.

evidence.detail: Defines liquidity confirmed momentum using volume/flow expansion.

proposals.expected_effect: Establishes an empirical baseline for trend acceleration and avoids entering false breakout signals.
proposals.rationale: Confirming momentum via liquidity and flow expansion protects the bot from buying into illiquid, highly-maniputable tokens. In the absence of live trading diagnostics, we must keep this strategy under SHADOW evaluation to calibrates optimal z-score thresholds (momentum_z >= 1.0, flow_acceleration_z >= 0.5) across different market regimes.
proposals.shadow_test: Observe 30 simulated entries over 14 days. Evaluate post-entry reversion over 24-hour holding windows. Verify that the asset exit occurs profitably or is safely stopped by the 10% stop-loss guard. Stop the test if simulated win rate drops below 45% or average entry slippage exceeds 2.5%.

proposals.downside_risk: If the price dislocation is caused by a fundamental contract exploit or permanent exit of liquidity, the position will exit at a stop-loss (10% max loss).

evidence.detail: Encourages creative AI strategy proposals that are declarative and uncorrelated with leader copy-trading.

proposals.expected_effect: Captures low-risk mean-reversion gains during brief market dislocations without taking on high-volatility structural decay risk.
proposals.rationale: We propose a new shadow strategy variant that specifically targets localized, high-velocity price dislocations on liquid pairs during sudden volatility spikes, provided the volatility remains within a bounded moderate range (volatility_z between 1.0 and 2.5). This avoids the 'falling knife' scenarios of extreme volatility (volatility_z > 3.0 is rejected by standard reversion) while exploiting short-term liquidity imbalances that are highly likely to revert.
proposals.shadow_test: Track at least 100 dislocation events across EVM and Solana over 14 days. Require dislocation_z > 1.8, liquidity_score > 0.75, and volatility_z between 1.0 and 2.5. Track exits at mean-reversion (z-score < 0.2) or 12-hour timeout. The strategy is falsified if total virtual drawdown exceeds 12% or if the simulated win rate is under 50%.

rejected_ideas.idea: Force automatic live trading of SiBot without complete history
rejected_ideas.reason: Allows copy-trading of wallets with incomplete or unreconciled history (e.g. unmatched sells). This violates strict safety controls. Incomplete histories can mask structural losses, LP provisioning, or non-spot transfer behaviors, which would expose live capital to high-risk non-profitable wallets.

rejected_ideas.idea: Allow AI strategy proposals to contain executable code scripts
rejected_ideas.reason: Permitting AI strategy models to submit direct python files/scripts to be executed in the runtime would violate critical security sandboxing and operational control. All AI proposals must remain strictly declarative data (JSON) registered within the Strategy Lab registry, reusing pre-vetted execution pathways.

summary: This strategy review has been completed using a pure architecture-only evaluation because the latest runtime evidence is unavailable (MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS). Consequently, no claims of live profitability, canary readiness, or live promotion are made. The review covers the multi-chain spot-copy engine (SiBot) on EVM and Solana, as well as the 7 built-in Strategy Lab market/pattern-learning families. We propose maintaining all active strategies under strict SHADOW evaluation to gather high-fidelity data, while introducing key structural improvements and a new volatility-dislocated mean reversion shadow strategy.
